findings.problem: Old call passed ENQUEUE_WAKEUP even when ENQUEUE_MIGRATED. New stats.h no longer uses sched_psi_wake_requeue; psi_ttwu_dequeue clears the old CPU PSI flags. Treating destination enqueue as same-CPU wakeup can clear already-cleared TSK_IOWAIT and omit restoring TSK_MEMSTALL.
findings.status: Main agent applied; re-read confirms fixed

checks.cgroup_tail: Current allocator/accessor use the same aligned base formula, leave all ancestor_ids and struct members unchanged, and assign cgrp->level before psi_cgroup_alloc. Root level0 returns psi_system, avoiding embedded cgroup_root corruption.
checks.cgroup_migration: css_set_move_task is the sole runtime css_set replacement path. RCU_INIT_POINTER calls are boot initialization and not-yet-runnable fork setup; cgroup_exit keeps the original css_set through final dequeue. Replacing the assignment in css_set_move_task is sufficient for these sources.
checks.cgroup_lifetime: PSI allocation failure unwinds ID/rstat/ref state. Successful group free cancels PSI work before releasing its allocation. Two-phase worker creation keeps cgroup pinned while dropping cgroup_mutex, re-fetches of->priv before publication, and frees the unpublished trigger on release/race.
checks.cgroup_poll: cftype release callback identifies only pressure files; other files use generic kernfs poll. per-open trigger wait registration uses kernfs open-node waitqueue rather than a short-lived PSI trigger waitqueue.
checks.task_bitfields: in_memstall at storage byte936 bit5; all pre-existing task members and bit positions match kernel6. fork resets psi_flags and in_memstall before runnable publication.
checks.workqueue_tail: alloc_worker is used by both ordinary worker and rescuer allocation; it reserves the private last-function tail word. No struct worker field was added.
checks.layout: Final vmlinux surviving DWARF:491 shared complete types vs kernel6 header probe, zero old-member/size differences. Full debug info is disabled. Missing types retain explicit supplemental-probe provenance; neither final-vmlinux rq layout nor kernel6 rq equivalence is claimed.

remaining_validation: Physical hardware trial, real I/O-pressure event generation, dedicated cross-CPU stalled-task wake migration stress and long soak are not covered.
